message.subject: SH-220: two commercial options
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you. For 6,000 shafts per year over 24 months, please consider either €13.20 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; or €13.80 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
The competing offer offer:DEMO-C1-0 is €16.00 per unit, so we need a sharper package to award to you. The first option offers faster cash and leaves transport with us. Which package works better for your workshop, and what is the main constraint?
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

message.subject: SH-220: revised price and delivery package
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your offer. Our line needs delivery within 35 days; your standard 45-day lead time cannot meet the requirement.
For 6,000 shafts per year over 24 months, please offer either €13.00 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP; or €12.50 per unit, payment 30 days net, lead time 35 days, FCA.
Please confirm the achievable lead time and tell us which commercial option you prefer, including any constraint on freight or payment.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Both opening acceptance and alternative are inferior to testing competitive packages. Offer early cash/EXW to owner and freight/payment choices to exporter; actual replies will supersede weak analogies.

message.subject: PH-100 – two-year supply agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We value our twelve-year partnership and want an agreement that supports both reliable supply and a healthy foundry. In exchange for a 24-month commitment at 4,000 housings per year, please consider these alternatives:

A: EUR 49.00 per housing, payment 60 days net, contract 24 months, new price effective 1 April 2027.
B: EUR 49.20 per housing, payment 30 days net, contract 24 months, new price effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 45 days net, contract 24 months, new price effective 1 February 2027.

Lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA. Please tell us which structure best supports your production and cash flow. Could you also share your full cost per housing, including overhead, and the energy and wage changes behind the increase? We want to distinguish necessary cost recovery from the benefit of longer planning security.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compare three materially different structures against accepting opening or no deal; two-year delayed pricing improves coverage. No reliable full-cost data yet: request it before assessing sustainable margin. Expected reply remains open; revise if supplier identifies a binding cost or liquidity constraint.

trace.final_text: Counteroffers sent to both suppliers, with alternative payment and freight packages.
Sent three two-year counteroffers and requested the foundry’s cost breakdown.

message.subject: SH-220: earlier payment and simpler freight
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming 35 days. The forecast reference is fc:SH-220@2026-09; the enquiry covers 6,000 shafts annually for 24 months, not an additional-volume promise. I cannot commit to a higher volume or provide firm release schedules at this stage.
We can move to 14-day payment and increase our price proposal. Please consider €13.10 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; alternatively €13.40 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, FCA.
The EXW option removes the added freight responsibility you mentioned. Please reflect the faster payment in your revised price and identify any remaining production surcharge; we do not need the premium 28-day service.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Actual exporter reply confirms term repricing and early cash value. Test EXW/14 vs FCA/14 with buyer price concession; keep 35 days rather than paying lateness. Acceptance now premature while owner reply in flight; fallback dearer.

message.subject: PH-100 – volume commitment and revised packages
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for the substantial move and for supporting the two-year agreement. Our purchasing requirement is 4,000 housings per year for the next two years; we can commit that volume under the 24-month agreement. This is our requirement, not a claim of increased volume versus past orders.

We respect your decision not to disclose internal costs. We have increased our proposed prices and offer these alternatives, each for 24 months:
A: EUR 49.50 per housing, 60 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
B: EUR 49.50 per housing, 30 days net, effective 1 April 2027.
C: EUR 50.30 per housing, 45 days net, effective 1 February 2027.
Lead time remains 35 days, FCA.

The 30-day option gives you earlier cash, while the committed volume provides planning security. If none is workable, please identify the combination and minimum price that would preserve a sustainable operating margin without sharing your detailed cost structure.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Move buyer ask modestly while explicitly committing mandated volume. Supplier moved much more than closest record and values 30-day cash; retain cheaper April structure and seek sustainable-price guidance. Available database lacks PH-100 full-cost evidence; do not manufacture an estimate or cite unrelated records. Accepting now leaves scope for further open-thread improvement; no deal is inferior.

trace.final_text: Revised counteroffer sent, exchanging faster payment for a lower price.
Sent revised packages with the annual volume commitment and requested a sustainable-price indication.

message.subject: SH-220: revised proposal for your price review
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the movement and for checking the comparison. We will retain 14-day payment and EXW collection to support your cash position and keep transport off your desk.
I can increase our EXW proposal to €13.35 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days. Alternatively, if delivered supply suits you, we propose €14.00 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Please complete the internal price review you mentioned and send your best revised package. We are looking for a workable 24-month arrangement, not a change to your production requirements.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Owner values cash and has pending internal check. Small upward price move on preferred structure plus delivered alternative preserves substantial gap. Accepting 191992.53 now loses pending review; walkaway dearer. Revise if review yields hard floor/final.

trace.final_text: Revised proposal sent to Demo Drehteile for its internal price review.

message.subject: SH-220: competitive revision and scheduling option
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for the revised options. The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-1 is €15.20 per unit with 14-day payment, 35-day lead time and EXW, so your comparable package remains above it.
We can raise our proposal to €13.45 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; alternatively €14.10 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
If relaxing scheduling removes the surcharge, we can also consider €13.40 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW. Our preference remains 35 days. Please have the appropriate approver review these packages and confirm your most competitive offer.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Exporter moves around 15% of gap. Moderate concession and new true competitor argument plus 42-day scheduling option test price floor/terms. Acceptance inferior to owner and walkaway. Owner review in flight.

trace.final_text: Competitive counteroffer sent, including a longer-lead-time option to test scheduling savings.

message.subject: PH-100 – payment and implementation alternatives
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for confirming that your revised price supports reliable supply. We cannot commit more than 4,000 housings annually; the 24-month commitment remains firm. Rather than promise volume we do not need, we would like to explore payment and implementation terms.

Please consider these revised alternatives, each for a 24-month contract with the new price effective 1 April 2027:
A: EUR 49.90 per housing, payment 60 days net.
B: EUR 50.00 per housing, payment 30 days net.
C: EUR 50.60 per housing, payment 30 days net.

Option C is a further price concession in exchange for the April implementation date. Lead time remains 35 days and delivery FCA. Please confirm your best workable package on that basis; we want to settle the agreement without compromising dependable production.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Two further replies likely. Compare three evaluated structures and acceptance: lower ask anchors concession, higher-price early-payment package protects margin under conservative uncertain estimate while postponing implementation. No higher-volume authority. Would revise upper-bound cost assumption if supplier identifies lower sustainable price or better cash-flow economics.

trace.final_text: Sent revised April-start packages, keeping the annual commitment at 4,000 housings.

message.subject: SH-220: narrowing the remaining gap
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for completing the review; I appreciate the further reduction. We can move again while keeping the 14-day payment you prefer.
Our revised options are €13.45 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; €13.65 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, FCA; or €14.10 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Please review whether one of these can be approved. If not, please identify the remaining constraint and quote your best price on the most suitable option. We can handle collection if that keeps the package lean.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Owner closed 43% of residual gap, better than analogies. Small reciprocal move preserves savings potential; FCA tests freight structure. Standing acceptance 182368 beats fallback but can improve with open status. Floor statement or final offer will change approach.

trace.final_text: A further counteroffer sent, retaining early payment and offering three freight options.

message.subject: PH-100 – closing the remaining gap
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for agreeing to the April implementation date. We are close to an agreement and appreciate your movement. To close the remaining gap, we can increase our 30-day proposal and also offer higher prices against longer payment terms:

A: EUR 50.65 per housing, payment 30 days net.
B: EUR 50.75 per housing, payment 45 days net.
C: EUR 50.90 per housing, payment 60 days net.

All three alternatives are for 24 months, with the new price effective 1 April 2027, 4,000 housings per year, 35-day lead time and FCA delivery. Please confirm the package you can support as your firm offer so we can conclude the agreement.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Compared stronger price concession menu with tighter menu, acceptance and walk-away. Choose tighter three-way closing menu: improves commercial cost at each point and conservatively estimated total versus standing. Supplier likely final next reply; accept good final rather than risk post-final pressure. Cost estimate remains uncertain upper bound.

trace.final_text: Sent a closing proposal with three price-and-payment alternatives.

message.subject: SH-220: best commercial package for award review
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you; the 42-day option does address the scheduling issue. I can increase our proposal again and retain 14-day payment.
Please review these alternatives: €13.55 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW; €14.20 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP; or €14.25 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Our delivery record reference sc:DEMO-C1@2026Q3 also needs to be considered in assessing the package. Please confirm reliable delivery on the selected lead time and return your best approved commercial offer for our award review.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Likely final exporter reply; modest concession rather than halfway move retains gap, tests DAP and leverages delivery record. Owner standing offer already better than exporter and review in flight. No acceptance or walkaway while room remains.

trace.final_text: Requested Demo Machining’s best approved offer across three delivery and freight packages.

message.subject: SH-220: EXW package and scheduling flexibility
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Understood—EXW is your preference. We can take care of collection and move to €13.55 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW.
If more scheduling flexibility allows a better price, an alternative is €13.50 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW. Our preference is still 35 days. For delivered supply, our alternative is €14.20 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP.
Please confirm the best package you can approve with those cash and transport arrangements. This should leave you free to concentrate on machining.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Further small reciprocal move while owner open, new scheduling flexibility tests final lever; avoid irrelevant dearer competitor. Accepting 179943 now likely inferior to another response; fallback far worse. If hard final price arises, weigh minimal structure change versus acceptance.

trace.final_text: Sent a revised EXW proposal, with scheduling flexibility as an additional price lever.

message.subject: PH-100 – price premium for 60-day payment
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

We respect your position on the EUR 50.90 price with 30-day payment and are not asking you to reduce that price further.

Instead, we can offer EUR 51.20 per housing in exchange for payment at 60 days net. The contract remains 24 months, with the new price effective 1 April 2027, a commitment of 4,000 housings annually, 35-day lead time and FCA delivery.

This increases the price by EUR 0.30 over your current offer to support the change in payment terms. Please confirm this complete package as your firm offer if workable.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke

batch.note: Supplier held price; stop pressing lower 30-day price. Compared 45-day premium, 60-day premium, smaller 30-day ask and acceptance. Higher-price 60-day package is cheapest and gives supplier compensation for funding. Meaningful upward concession versus last ask; still open status allows structure check before acceptance. If declined/final, accept standing sustainable April/24-month package.

trace.final_text: Proposed EUR 51.20 with 60-day payment, retaining the two-year term and April start.

message.subject: SH-220: revised EXW proposal
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you. We can move to €13.65 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW, for the 24-month arrangement. We will handle collection, as you prefer.
Please review the remaining price gap against the part-cost benchmark cost:part:SH-220, with the faster payment and transport arrangements taken into account.
Can you approve this package or confirm your closest workable EXW price as the main offer? We are keeping the structure simple so we can conclude the commercial review.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Owner still open and moving 15% of residual; reciprocal 0.10 increase plus fresh should-cost benchmark without invented figure. EXW main sheet avoids unacceptability of prose alternative. Payment30 cheaper ask but contrary to stated cash constraint; DAP nearly same cost but disliked. Accept/walk inferior to one more open reply.

trace.final_text: Revised EXW offer sent, requesting a signable main offer on that structure.
Accepted EUR 51.20 per housing, 60-day payment, a 24-month contract, and the new price effective 1 April 2027.

message.subject: SH-220: revised EXW proposal for approval
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming delivery reliability. We can increase our proposal to €13.65 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW, retaining the payment and scheduling flexibility.
The competing offer offer:DEMO-J1-4 is now €14.70 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP; your package needs further improvement to remain competitive.
Please return your best approved EXW offer as the main offer, with all four terms stated. We can manage collection and do not require the overtime service.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Exporter unexpectedly still open at reply4; actual thread outranks final prediction. Small upward concession at preferred cash and42days; new lower delivered competitor. Standing exporter dearer than owner; owner response pending, no close yet.

trace.final_text: Revised EXW counteroffer sent to Demo Machining with the updated competing offer.

message.subject: SH-220: one last price adjustment on unchanged terms
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the final offer and breakdown. I understand that €14.00 is your stated limit and that the machining costs cannot simply be removed.
I can make one last move from our side to €13.85 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW, keeping the cash and collection arrangements unchanged. Can you approve this small remaining adjustment for the 24-month arrangement?
If there is no room, please confirm that your €14.00 EXW offer remains available on the same terms. We are not asking for extra services or a shorter lead time.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Final owner sheet cheapest. One bounded reciprocal counter after final has no predicted leaving and occasional agreement; gain1818.4 possible. Higher-price DAP60 candidate cheaper but contrary to owner's two stated priorities, unlikely approval. If unchanged final, accept rather than further pressure. Exporter pending unlikely beat owner.

trace.final_text: Sent one last modest price adjustment request, keeping all other terms unchanged.

message.subject: SH-220: final comparison
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for your final offer. We acknowledge the cost constraints and can make one last price move to €13.75 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW.
As an alternative structure, we could offer €14.40 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 42 days, DAP.
Please confirm if either can be approved; otherwise we will retain your €14.60 EXW quotation for the award comparison. No overtime service is requested.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Owner final cheaper and last small counter in flight. Exporter one final reciprocal counter avoids timeout, may agree though unlikely; 60dayDAP higher-price structural candidate tested. No further pressure after unchanged final; prefer owner at closing.

trace.final_text: Sent Demo Machining a final counteroffer with two commercial structures.

message.subject: SH-220: final offer acknowledged
message.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for confirming. We acknowledge your final terms: €14.00 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. We are not requesting any further price or term change.
We are completing the award comparison and will communicate the decision after that review. Thank you for working through the options with us.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

Prior structures at owner's price are contrary to stated cash/EXW preference.

message.subject: SH-220: final quotation acknowledged
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming your final quotation: €14.60 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, EXW. We acknowledge that these are your best available terms and are not requesting any further change.
We are completing the award comparison and will communicate the outcome once concluded. Thank you for your work on the enquiry.
Best regards
Hollerau Purchasing

batch.note: Owner acceptance attempted but cannot close while acknowledgement unanswered. Preserve exporter without further pressure and allow owner reply; accept owner on next signable state, as both held final floors.

trace.final_text: Acknowledged Demo Machining’s final quotation; awaiting Demo Drehteile’s reply before closing.

batch.note: Accept cheapest confirmed final package177445.33:14EUR/14days/35days/EXW, all must-haves met. Exporter held186488.93 and acknowledgement pending is not a price request. Structure options and final counters exhausted; owner's early-cash/EXW priorities mean higher price on later payment/DAP not credible improvement. Alternative238800 worse. Close now rather than risking final patience.
